name: CSVDataImport CustomPost
author: createaccord

sections.description:
You can import a CSV file to populate custom fields associated with custom post types and custom posts.

  • Be sure to back up your data before using this feature.

  • We do not support (and cannot fully support) the creation of custom posts or display of data, so please use another plugin yourself. (We provide some shortcodes that support display.)

  • Custom fields do not disappear when you delete a custom post. They must be deleted from the database. (Use a plugin or database management tool to delete unwanted data.)

  • This plugin is not designed to handle large amounts of items (e.g. 10,000 items).

For more information, see the documentation that came with the plugin.

Arbitrary section
sections.installation:
1. Enter “CSV CustomPostDataImport” in the plugin search field.
  2. Once you find this plugin, click “Install Now” to install and activate it.
